title: Vermilion Reloaded 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid by Zeus Juice
description: Zeus Juice Vermilion Reloaded 100ml shortfill is a reloaded blend of Vermilion yet with even more menthol and aniseed. A sweet and bold shade of cherry, topped with spicy aniseed and intense menthol kick. Mixed to a 70/30 VG/PG ratio, Vermilion Reloaded by Zeus Juice is supplied in a 120ml bottle, filled with 100ml nicotine-free e-liquid.
